verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a REST API, CLI, and webhooks that can be wired into external cron/CI pipelines (e.g., 'Run Mercury operations from your terminal, a script, or a CI pipeline'), and supports some built-in recurring behaviors like automatic invoices and auto-funding rules, but there is no native scheduler or workflow-orchestration feature for recurring jobs—automation must be self-built externally, and the MCP server is read-only so it can't trigger recurring actions.
